rules: Clients must not infer authorization from UI visibility.
Idempotent write operations should send the server-supported idempotency key where documented.
X-Request-ID is diagnostic and must not be treated as an authentication credential.
Only approved campaigns inside their start/end window are public.
Destination URLs are allowlisted to http/https/tg/bale.
Impressions/clicks are de-duplicated per campaign/fingerprint/event over a rolling 24h window.
Raw IP/user-agent values are not persisted; HMAC fingerprints are used.
